name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 and brought in 5 leads at $43.90 each from 11,850 impressions and 150 clicks.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads on $153.40 spend, with a $30.68 cost per lead, 8,800 impressions, 120 clicks, and a 1.4% click rate.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead.
November 2026 is 28 days from close; Meta spend so far this month is $487.00.

The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) shows 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion. The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) shows 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded.
